channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula enaltece inteligęncia de alunos cearenses após desempenho na prova do ITA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised the performance of Ceará students admitted to the ITA, noting that 40% of the institution's entrants come from the state. He emphasized their intelligence, rejecting stereotypes about Ceará's population by stating, 'It's not just that their heads are big — it's their intelligence.'

item.title: Planalto pede adiamento da votação de projeto sobre trabalho por app
item.description: The Lula government requested the postponement of the vote on the bill regulating app-based work due to lack of consensus among lawmakers. New Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães said the move aims to avoid political wear and enable negotiations with party leaders before revisiting the issue, following a deadlock over the report by Deputy Augusto Coutinho.

item.title: Haddad mapeia “vulnerabilidades” do governo Tarcísio em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad met with state deputies from the governing coalition in Pacaembu to structure his campaign for the São Paulo gubernatorial race and map vulnerabilities in Tarcísio’s government. The two-hour meeting took place at the residence that will serve as campaign headquarters and included representatives from PT, PCdoB, and PV. The goal is to identify weaknesses in the current administration to strengthen the opposition ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula: ‘Nunca gostei de cartão de crédito, mas me convenceram que o PT precisava para os filiados'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an interview that he never liked credit cards but was convinced by his partner Clara Ant that the PT needed one for its members. He tried to obtain the card at Banco do Brasil and Caixa without success, eventually securing it through Lázaro Brandão of Bradesco, who advanced R$ 500,000 to the party. Lula said Bradesco 'took a loss' because electoral justice barred the PT from advertising the card in return for the loan.

item.title: José Guimarães repete gesto de Bolsonaro com caneta de Lula
item.description: Deputy José Guimarães (PT) used a pen belonging to Lula during his swearing-in as Minister of Institutional Relations, repeating a symbolic gesture associated with Jair Bolsonaro. The ceremony took place at the Palácio do Planalto with Lula, congressional leaders, and about two-thirds of the Chamber of Deputies present. Guimarães replaced Gleisi Hoffmann and emphasized dialogue with Congress as central to his role in coordinating the government's political agenda.

item.title: Lula cita inteligência de alunos do Ceará e diz que ‘não é só a cabeça grande não’
item.description: President Lula praised the academic performance of students from Ceará admitted to the Aeronautics Institute of Technology (ITA), noting that 40% of its entrants come from the state and challenging regional prejudices. He announced that the new ITA campus in Fortaleza, set to be fully operational by 2027, serves as recognition of this talent and is part of a federal strategy to prevent brain drain. Lula also referenced the creation of IMPA in Rio de Janeiro and the interest of 76 municipalities in establishing Federal Institutes, emphasizing education as the engine of national development.

item.title: Gilmar diz que Alessandro Vieira ‘se esqueceu de seus colegas milicianos’ em relatório da CPI
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes criticized Senator Alessandro Vieira for his report in the Organized Crime CPI, which proposes the indictment of three STF ministers and the Attorney General, claiming Vieira 'forgot his milician colleagues'. Mendes said the inclusion of his name in the indictment list is 'curious' and reflects a decline in moral standards, citing the decision to suspend the breaking of Maridt's bank secrecy as an act incompatible with his office.

item.title: TCU instaura processo para apurar interferência política na Petrobras
item.description: The TCU has initiated an investigation into possible political interference in Petrobras' management, following the dismissal of executive director Claudio Romeo Schlosser and President Lula's criticism of a GLP auction. The case, filed under nº 007.336/2026-8, will be reported by Minister Antonio Anastasia and will assess whether there were violations of the State Enterprises Law, fiduciary duties, and public administration principles, amid an election year and rising fuel prices.

item.title: É #FAKE que Flávio Bolsonaro defendeu fim do Pix em evento nos Estados Unidos
item.description: False social media posts claim Senator Flávio Bolsonaro advocated ending the PIX system during a U.S. event, using an altered image showing him wearing a U.S. flag-patterned blazer and a fabricated quote. His office confirmed the image is a montage and that he never made such a statement, having previously opposed the narrative. The disinformation emerged after his CPAC speech on March 28 and coincided with Trump administration criticism of PIX, but no factual basis exists for the claims.

item.title: Fim da escala 6×1: Motta aceita envio de projeto de lei com urgência pelo governo
item.description: Speaker of the Chamber of Deputies Hugo Motta told President Lula he accepts the government's submission of a bill with constitutional urgency to end the 6×1 work schedule. The statement was made during lunch at the Palácio do Planalto on Tuesday, the 14th. Motta said he will maintain the bill’s legislative timetable.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta aumento de mais de 70% de eleitores 60+ em 16 anos
item.description: The number of Brazilian voters aged 60 and over increased by 74% since 2010, rising from 20.8 million to 36.2 million by March 2026, according to Nexus research. This growth far exceeds the 15% increase in the total electorate over the same period, making seniors account for roughly 25% of the potential voting population in the 2026 elections. Although not legally required to vote, voters aged 60+ have shown rising turnout, with abstention declining since 2014, turning this group into a strategic target in a highly polarized political climate.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes diz que Alessandro Vieira 'esqueceu dos seus colegas milicianos e decidiu envolver o STF'
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes criticized the report of the Organized Crime CPI presented by Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), accusing him of 'forgetting his milician colleagues' and improperly involving the STF by proposing the indictment of ministers and the Attorney General. Mendes called the report 'tacky', a 'technical mistake' and a 'historical error', stating that excesses by the commission could constitute abuse of authority, punishable by 1 to 4 years in prison.

item.title: PL e Novo fecham questão contra indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: The PL and Novo party caucuses in the Federal Senate have closed ranks against the nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the STF and against President Lula’s veto of the Dosimetry Bill. The move comes ahead of Messias’ confirmation hearing and the vote to overturn the veto, signaling partisan opposition to both the nomination and the veto’s upholding.

item.title: Lula diz que Ancelotti pediu opinião sobre convocar Neymar para Copa
item.description: Lula stated that Ancelotti sought his opinion on whether Neymar should be called up for the 2026 World Cup, emphasizing that the player must be physically ready and motivated by football, not fame. He suggested Neymar could look to Cristiano Ronaldo and Messi as examples, but stressed that the decision hinges on the player's professionalism and willingness. Neymar has not played for Brazil since October 2023 due to injury and has not been included in any squad by Ancelotti since he took charge in May 2025.

item.title: Lula defende previdência social para profissionais de aplicativos
item.description: President Lula advocated for social security coverage for app-based workers, suggesting contributions could come from either the workers or digital platforms. He emphasized the need for social protection in case of accidents and noted the government is negotiating a project with representative entities to improve working conditions, including fair wages and basic infrastructure such as rest and charging stations.

item.title: Relator da CPI rebate críticas de ministros do STF sobre pedidos de indiciamentos: 'Não são donos do país'
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira, rapporteur of the Organized Crime CPI, pushed back against STF criticism, stating ministers "are not the owners of the country" and refusing to yield to threats, defending legislative independence. He cited remarks by Gilmar Mendes and Dias Toffoli about possible electoral punishments as explicit intimidation. The CPI report calls for the indictment of four STF ministers and the Attorney General in the Banco Master case for crimes of responsibility.

item.title: Haddad se reúne com deputados aliados para mapear temas que devem ser usados contra Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad met with allied state deputies from PT, PCdoB, and PV to map campaign themes against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, including security, corruption in Finance, Sabesp privatization, transportation, economy, and education. Held at the former residence of ex-minister Delfim Netto (future campaign HQ), the meeting also discussed leveraging Haddad’s federal tenure as Finance Minister, particularly inflation control data, and left the ticket composition undefined. Despite two absent deputies, participants expressed motivation to defeat Tarcísio in the 2026 elections.

item.title: PCO critica tentativa de aproximação do PT ao PSDB: “Desespero”
item.description: PCO leader Rui Costa Pimenta denounced the PT-PSDB rapprochement in São Paulo as a 'desperation move,' claiming the PSDB represents the 'shadow of the bourgeoisie' per Trotsky and that such alliances weaken the left. He also dismissed Fernando Haddad’s praise of the PSDB as 'unbelievable' and reiterated that the PSDB was 'the worst thing to happen to Brazil.'

item.title: CPI do Crime faz última sessão com leitura de relatório; acompanhe
item.description: The Parliamentary Inquiry Committee (CPI) on Organized Crime held its final session to read the report by Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), which calls for the indictment of three Supreme Court justices — Dias Toffoli, Alexandre de Moraes and Gilmar Mendes — and the head of the Federal Public Ministry, Paulo Gonet, over alleged irregularities in the Banco Master case. Following government-led changes to the committee, the vote is expected to be four in favor and six against the report. The accusations center on objective bias, conflicts of interest, and the annulment of CPI decisions.

item.title: TRE destrava eleição para o comando da Alerj, mas oposição pressiona para adiar votação
item.description: The TRE-RJ unanimously confirmed the cassation of Rodrigo Bacellar (União) and validated that Carlos Augusto Nogueira Pinto (PL) will assume his seat in the Alerj, completing the legislative composition. The ruling allows for a new vote on the presidency of the Assembly, but opposition parties are pushing to delay it until the STF rules on the 'buffer election' for governor, citing legal and institutional infeasibility.

item.title: Flamengo bate o Fluminense no Maracanã pelo Brasileirão
item.description: Flamengo defeated Fluminense 2-1 at Maracanã in the 11th round of the 2026 Brasileirão, with Pedro scoring both goals. The win keeps Flamengo in second place with 20 points and a goal difference of +8, while Fluminense remains fourth with 20 points and a +5 goal difference.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro negocia acordo com centrão, e Novo desiste de candidatura ao TCU
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for president from PL-RJ, is negotiating an agreement with part of the centrão and the right to form an alliance capable of defeating the PT’s candidate for the TCU. The talks took place on Tuesday, April 14, 2026, aiming to consolidate political support around an alternative to Lula’s government at the Federal Court of Accounts. The Novo party has abandoned its own TCU candidacy, aligning with the opposition’s strategy.

item.title: Lançamento de livro de Gabriela Biló em SP reúne José Dirceu e Natuza Nery
item.description: Photojournalist Gabriela Biló launched her book 'Juízo Final: Tentativa e Fracasso do Golpe no Brasil' at an event in Megafauna bookstore, São Paulo, attended by José Dirceu and Natuza Nery. The launch took place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, gathering guests to discuss the book's analysis of the coup attempt in Brazil.

item.title: Lula sanciona Plano Nacional de Educação e critica escolas cívico-militares
item.description: President Lula signed the new National Education Plan (PNE) without including homeschooling, which was blocked by Congress. During the event at the Palácio do Planalto, he criticized civic-military schools, reaffirming his opposition to the militarized education model in public schools.

item.title: Saiba como é o PL dos aplicativos e o que o governo Lula rejeita
item.description: PLP 152/2025 regulates app-based work in Brazil, keeping workers as independent contractors with a R$ 8.50 per ride floor and caps on platform fees. The Lula government opposes the report, advocating for R$ 10 per ride, distance-based supplements, night and holiday pay, stronger social security contributions, and reduced business secrecy. Drivers protested in São Paulo, and the rapporteur Augusto Coutinho canceled the scheduled vote.

item.title: Davi Alcolumbre mandou diretas a Lula e ao PT e fez média com o STF no Planalto
item.description: Congress President Davi Alcolumbre strongly criticized attacks on institutions and disregard for institutional limits during a speech at the Planalto Palace, directing his remarks at Lula, his government, and the PT, which often blames the Legislature for lack of progress. He also defended the STF against the Organized Crime CPI, which sought unsubstantiated indictments of justices and the PGR chief, warning against institutional victimization. Though he did not name him directly, Alcolumbre indicated his message included Senator Alessandro Vieira, rapporteur of the CPI and a vocal critic of STF justices in the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: Vídeo: ‘Não é só cabeça grande’, diz Lula ao elogiar alunos do Ceará
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised the intelligence of students from Ceará, stating that their high admission rate to the ITA is not just due to 'big heads' but to real intellectual ability. He noted that 40% of ITA students are from Ceará and announced the establishment of an ITA unit in Fortaleza as a reward for the state's performance. Lula also launched the new National Education Plan and highlighted investments in institutions like IMPA to support talented students.

item.title: Lula chama “taxa das blusinhas” de desnecessária e governo prepara pacote para consumo
item.description: President Lula criticized the 'little shirts tax' as unnecessary, acknowledging it mainly affected low-income consumers who buy cheap products on international sites like Shein and Shopee. He said the government is preparing a package for the popular economy, focused on reducing household debt, raising income, and strengthening consumption to mitigate the measure's impacts. The tax, which applies to international purchases under $50 with around 20% federal tax plus a minimum 17% ICMS, was approved by Congress with national retail support to balance competition and protect public revenue.

item.title: Vitória surpreende o São Paulo e triunfa no Barradão
item.description: Vitória defeated São Paulo 2-0 at Barradão Stadium in the 11th round of the Brazilian Championship, with goals from Cacá and Ramon. The win moved Vitória to 10th place with 14 points, while São Paulo, in third with 20 points, failed to score and saw their goal difference drop to 6.

item.title: Moro denuncia “manobra vergonhosa” de Lula na CPI do Crime Organizado
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL) denounced as 'shameful' the government coalition's maneuver to alter the composition of the Organized Crime CPI, removing him and Marcos do Val and replacing them with Beto Faro (PT-PA) and Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), plus Soraya Thronicke replacing Jorge Kajuru. Moro accused the Lula government of attempting to block the final report vote of the commission.

item.title: Bahia vence o Mirassol fora de casa e segue na parte alta da tabela
item.description: Bahia defeated Mirassol 2-1 away, with goals from Luciano Juba (penalty) and Sanabria, rising to 5th place in the Brasileirão with 20 points after 11 matches. Mirassol, who led via an own goal by David Duarte, remain bottom with 6 points.

item.title: Lula empossa novo articulador com sinal de reaproximação do Congresso
item.description: José Guimarães was sworn in as minister of the Secretariat of Institutional Relations, replacing Gleisi Hoffmann, with Lula, Hugo Motta, and Davi Alcolumbre present, signaling congressional rapprochement. Guimarães emphasized dialogue as the cornerstone of governance, stating there is no government without engagement with Congress. Alcolumbre, after months of absence, attended the ceremony, criticized institutional aggression, but pledged openness to dialogue.

item.title: Lula sanciona novo PNE, com metas da educação brasileira para os próximos dez anos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the new National Education Plan (PNE), establishing 19 goals for Brazilian education over the next ten years, including universal preschool for 4- and 5-year-olds by 2026 and literacy for 100% of children by the end of second grade. The plan projects investments equivalent to 11% of GDP — 7.5% from public sources and 3.5% from the private sector — with emphasis on equity, school infrastructure, connectivity, and teacher valorization.

item.title: Toffoli fala em deixar inelegível senador que pediu indiciamento de ministros do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli suggested that Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) should be declared ineligible for requesting the indictment of three justices, including himself, in the final report of the Organized Crime CPI. He called the report an 'excrescence' lacking legal or factual basis, labeling it an abuse of power and an attempt to obtain votes through antidemocratic means that corrupt the electoral process. Toffoli urged the Electoral Justice to act, stating that those who attack institutions to gain votes do not deserve electoral eligibility, as their votes are 'tainted' and corrupt.

item.title: Mesa carioca sai enfraquecida no novo Guia Michelin 2026
item.description: The 2026 Michelin Guide highlighted the strength of São Paulo's gastronomy, with Tuju and Evvai each earning three stars, making Brazil the only country in Latin America to achieve this top recognition. In contrast, Rio de Janeiro emerged weakened, retaining only its two-starred restaurants (Lasai and Oro) and securing limited accolades, including a first star for Madame Olympe, the Best Service award for Raphael Zanon (Casa 201), and the Best Young Chef title for Pedro Corona (Koral), plus a Bib Gourmand. Despite these bright spots, Rio's culinary scene received minimal overall recognition at the ceremony.

item.title: Lula sanciona novo Plano Nacional de Educação; proposta define metas para os próximos 10 anos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the new National Education Plan (PNE) for 2026-2036, setting 19 objectives, 73 goals, and 372 strategies for Brazilian education. The plan includes targets such as expanding daycare coverage to 60% of children under 3, ensuring preschool for all 4- and 5-year-olds, achieving literacy for 80% of students by 2nd grade, and reinstating public education investment goals unmet in the previous plan (2014-2025). Lula stressed the need for monitoring and criticized denialism as a barrier to effective educational policy.

item.title: Governo da Bahia gastou R$ 6 milhões em camarote institucional que recepcionou Lula no Carnaval
item.description: The Bahia state government spent R$6 million on a sponsorship quota for the setup and operation of an institutional box during Salvador's Carnival, which hosted President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The expense was allocated in the Campo Grande circuit and sparked controversy over the use of public funds for a festive event. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo nega “candidatura laranja”: “Tenho uma biografia”
item.description: Aldo Rebelo, former minister and presidential pre-candidate for the DC party, denied that his candidacy is a 'dummy candidacy' meant only for debate participation, insisting he has a substantial political biography. He rejected comparisons to Padre Kelmon and asserted his campaign is genuine and rooted in his track record.

item.title: ‘Não é só cabeça grande, não’, diz Lula ao exaltar inteligência de estudantes cearenses
item.description: Lula praised Ceará students for their high admission rate to the Aeronautics Institute of Technology (ITA), noting that 40% of ITA students are from Ceará and joking, 'It's not just that their heads are big, it's intelligence'. He highlighted the achievement as a result of local students' efforts. The remark sparked controversy due to its resemblance to past Bolsonaro jokes about Northeasterners, which the PT had previously condemned.

item.title: Lula repete Haddad e renega a taxa das blusinhas
item.description: President Lula (PT) reiterated former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad’s stance by rejecting the proposed tax on international purchases under $50, commonly known as the 'blusinhas tax,' calling it unnecessary. The remarks were made in interviews with pro-government outlets, signaling a continuation of a more lenient economic approach toward cross-border e-commerce.

item.title: Ministros do STF reagem a relatório da CPI que pede indiciamento de Moraes, Toffoli, Gilmar e Gonet por caso Master
item.description: STF ministers reacted to a report from the Organized Crime CPI requesting the indictment of Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, Gilmar Mendes, and Prosecutor-General Augusto Aras for responsibility crimes in the Master case. Gilmar Mendes called the report 'clumsy' and an institutional intimidation attempt, while Toffoli raised the possibility of removing parliamentarians. The STF faction views the move as electorally motivated and aimed at delegitimizing the Court, with additional criticism from Flávio Dino and the ANPR on social media.

item.title: Governo dos EUA divulga foto de Ramagem após ser preso pelo ICE; confira
item.description: Former federal deputy Alexandre Ramagem, an ally of Jair Bolsonaro, was arrested by ICE in the U.S. on February 13 after fleeing Brazil clandestinely via the Roraima-Guyana border. His mugshot was released by Orange County, Florida authorities, showing him wearing a green hooded jacket. Brazilian Federal Police confirmed international cooperation led to his detention, and extradition to Brazil is expected, where he was stripped of his mandate for alleged involvement in the 2022 coup attempt.

item.title: Após prisão, ICE publica foto e ficha de Ramagem
item.description: Former federal deputy Alexandre Ramagem was arrested by U.S. ICE on April 13, 2026, following a Brazilian Supreme Court conviction to 16 years in prison for attempting a coup. His mugshot and police record were published on the ICE official website, and he is now listed in the agency’s online detainee system. Ramagem, who fled Brazil in 2025 after losing his mandate, is under investigation by the Federal Police for alleged assistance in escaping the country.

item.title: Zezé Di Camargo manda recado a Bolsonaro: ‘Deve ter noção disso’; vídeo
item.description: Zezé Di Camargo met with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro at the 86th Expogrande in Campo Grande (MS) and sent a video message to former president Jair Bolsonaro, emphasizing his importance to Brazil and stating he remains by his side regardless of circumstances. The singer reiterated his public support, noting he sees Bolsonaro beloved by the people during his travels across the country.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro falta a depoimento no STF em processo sobre coação a autoridades no caso do tarifaço de Trump
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro failed to appear for a videoconference deposition at the STF in a case concerning coercion of authorities linked to the 'Trump tariff', without procedural prejudice. Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered additional diligences and opened a window for final arguments after the evidence production phase concludes. The Public Defender's Office is representing him due to his failure to appoint counsel or submit a prior defense.

item.title: Escala 6x1: governo e Câmara vão discutir tramitação de propostas, após almoço entre Lula e Motta
item.description: President Lula and House Speaker Hugo Motta met to align on ending the 6x1 work schedule, with the government pledging to send an urgent bill this week while the Chamber already has a constitutional amendment (PEC) under consideration. Motta, Institutional Relations Minister José Guimarães, and government leader Paulo Pimenta will coordinate to harmonize the processing of both the executive bill and the PEC. The issue is framed as a key social flagship of the government with broad popular appeal, particularly in the 2026 pre-election context.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro falta ao interrogatório online no STF determinado por Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) failed to attend an online interrogation ordered by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes on April 14 at 2 p.m., as he resides in the United States. He is charged with coercion in the course of justice for allegedly leveraging U.S. government contacts to pressure the Brazilian Supreme Court in the investigation into the January 8 coup attempt and the conviction of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years and 3 months in prison. The PGR’s indictment and Moraes’ ruling allege that Eduardo sought to intimidate judicial authorities by pursuing U.S. sanctions, including export tariffs, visa suspensions, and Magnitsky Act applications against Brazilian officials and the rapporteur minister.

item.title: O que der na urna, eu respeito; sempre respeitei a decisão da maioria, afirma Caiado
item.description: Former Goiás governor and PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado said he will respect the election results and that preventing the PT's return to power will be a greater challenge than defeating Lula.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro falta a interrogatório no STF
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) failed to attend his scheduled interrogation hearing at the STF this afternoon, where he is accused of attempting to coerce the Brazilian judiciary through U.S. government sanctions. His absence was noted by the judges and may carry procedural consequences. His defense has not yet justified the absence.

item.title: Flávio não é líder nacional nem tem vida própria, é delegado de Jair Bolsonaro, diz José Dirceu
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT) stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, is not a national leader nor has independent political life, but merely acts as a 'delegate' of former president Jair Bolsonaro.
